title: When the orchestrator sends work back, which agent gets it?
context: After reading a summary, the orchestrator sends an agent back for fixes or the next step. It can continue with the same agent, which keeps context but grows long, or start a new one from the board, which is clean but loses what the agent learned.

options.name: Always the same agent
options.summary: Fixes and next steps go back to the agent that did the work.

cons: Long agents slow down and lose focus

options.name: New agent per step
options.summary: Each next step starts a new agent that reads the board.

options.name: Same for fixes, new for new scope
options.summary: Fixes go back to the same agent; new scope, or an agent near its context limit, gets a new agent that starts from the board and a handoff memo.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='10' y='65' width='90' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='55' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Orchestrator</text><line x1='100' y1='80' x2='198' y2='45' stroke='currentColor'/><polygon points='198,45 193.1,50.0 191.0,44.3' fill='currentColor'/><line x1='100' y1='100' x2='198' y2='135' stroke='currentColor'/><polygon points='198,135 191.0,135.7 193.1,130.0' fill='currentColor'/><rect x='200' y='25' width='110' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='255' y='49' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Same agent</text><rect x='200' y='115' width='110' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='255' y='139' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>New agent</text><text x='150' y='50' font-size='11' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>fix</text><text x='150' y='140' font-size='11' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>new scope</text></svg>
pros: Context where it helps, clean starts where not
Workers retire the same way orchestrators do
cons: The orchestrator must judge when to split

recommendation: The same retire-and-handoff rule as the orchestrator role, applied to workers: fixes stay, new scope starts clean from the board.
